# Azure Synapse Spark Notebook (PySpark) - Silver Layer
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, when, round

# 1. Read Bronze Layer raw files
df = spark.read.format("csv") \
    .option("header", "true") \
    .option("inferSchema", "true") \
    .load("abfss://silver@myetlpipeline.dfs.core.windows.net/energy_mix_yearly_bronze_rawdata.csv")

# 2. Deduplicate and enforce schema
df_silver = df.dropDuplicates(["country", "year"]) \
    .withColumn("year", col("year").cast("integer")) \
    .withColumn("country", col("country").cast("string")) \
    .withColumn("iso3", col("iso3").cast("string")) \
    .withColumn("region", col("region").cast("string"))

# 3. Clip percentage values & compute derived metrics
pct_cols = ["coal_pct", "oil_pct", "gas_pct", "nuclear_pct", "hydro_pct", "solar_pct"]
for c in pct_cols:
    df_silver = df_silver.withColumn(c, when(col(c) < 0, 0.0).when(col(c) > 100, 100.0).otherwise(col(c).cast("double")))

df_silver = df_silver \
    .withColumn("fossil_pct", round(col("coal_pct") + col("oil_pct") + col("gas_pct"), 2)) \
    .withColumn("clean_pct", round(col("nuclear_pct") + col("hydro_pct") + col("solar_pct"), 2))
